summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine board committee chair succession: Roisin Donnelly will succeed Lena Wilson as Chair of the Group Performance and Remuneration Committee effective 1 October 2026. Chair Rick Haythornthwaite thanked Wilson and welcomed Donnelly, citing her board and remuneration experience. The filing states no further disclosure is required under UK Listing Rule 6.4.6R. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock are involved. This is an ordinary governance/board appointment notice equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
